workarounds.symptom: MCP tool canary: production tool failures
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): unlist the orbital tools while Orbital Watch is dark. Target files: api/_product-catalog.generated.js, api/mcp/alias.ts, api/mcp/constants.ts. Orbital Watch ships dark (#10710). In production, `ORBITAL_WATCH_ENABLED` is unset, so `api/orbital/v1/[rpc].ts` returns `404 {"error":"Not found"}` for every orbital RPC. I confirmed this on 2026-11-14: `GET /api/orbital/v1/get-point-passes` and `get-country-imagery-evidence` both return 404 with `cache-control: no-store`, which is the dark response. (Ref: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor/pull/10729)
